title: PrintTrack
tagline: Dashboard for managing printing consumables and costs by department.
description: I developed PrintTrack to centralise purchases, allocations and stocks of toner and paper. It calculates costs and flags shortages; this MVP stores data locally without a connected backend.
features: Dashboard with KPIs, recent trends and consumption/cost charts.
CRUD management of toner and paper purchases with filters, pagination and search.
Allocation of consumables by department, blocked when available stock is insufficient.
Automatic calculation of weighted average cost, stock value and available levels per reference.
Manual stock adjustments with real-time low-stock and out-of-stock alerts.
Cost analysis by department and by channel (Mono, CMYK, Paper) with Recharts charts.
CSV export of purchases and allocations.
Local settings for organisation, currency, alert threshold, command palette and keyboard shortcuts.
challenges: I brought toner and paper into a shared inventory model while handling their units and conversions. I also kept calculations, dashboards and exports consistent.
learnings: I learned to turn business rules into reliable calculations. Local storage also helped me identify what a future multi-user version would require.
